Sam: I accept these terms. Will practice my 'wherefore art thou scone' delivery.

Nora: Okay lineup: Diego, Priya, Sam. Judges: open to all, but please be kind.
Diego: Poem draft: "A scone in the window, butter like dawn; Office hearts mend by flaky brawn."

Sam: Poem draft (in iambic scone): "Shall I compare thee to a warm bready? Thou rise, my coffee, my steady."
Nora: Crowd reactions: :clap: :clap: :clap: Also scone claims: Diego -> lemon, Priya -> plain, Sam -> cinnamon. Snack-Bot: Reservations noted.

Diego: I'll design a tiny poster. 4pm micro-slam in the common area. Bring softness and poetic crumbs.
Snack-Bot: Calendar event created: "Micro Poetry & Scone Pledge" 4:00 PM today.
